newsitem.title: UK: Pace Micro upbeat on H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Pace Micro upbeat on H1 results.

text.p: Satellite receiver manufacturer Pace Micro Technology Plc said on Friday that it expects that results for the first half of the current financial year will be ahead of its initial expectations.

Peter Morgan, chairman of Pace Micro Technology, told the company's annual general meeting, "Traditionally, the business has been seasonal with lower profits in the first half, but we do not expect this seasonality to be so marked this year."
Shares in the company, which was floated in June, were 3-1/2p higher at 224-1/2 after the announcement.
